data.text/markdown:
Signal ablation: is there signal beyond recent form?

Question under test: are our features giving us enough signal to predict — or is the model mostly parroting recent points? Critically: how does it predict WITHOUT knowing points_last_3? Theory says trees shrug off useless columns (so we never bothered pruning), but that is not the same as having signal. This notebook ablates form away step by step and watches ranking + error collapse (or not). Protocol (mirrors model.py, read-only — nothing here touches data/):
  • Same paired X_<gw>/y_<gw> gameweeks, same minutes_last_3 row filter, same one-hot + HGB pipeline shape.
  • Leave-one-gameweek-out backtest over every paired gameweek.
  • One fixed estimator for all HGB arms: the production rank champ (max_depth=2, heavy L2) — so any gap is features, not tuning.
  • Arms: FULL vs NO_PTS3 (drop only points_last_3) vs NO_FORM (drop points_last_3, xg_last_3, minutes_last_3) vs FORM_ONLY (just those three) vs two naive baselines (train-mean, sort-by-points_last_3).
Run it: venv311/bin/marimo edit experiments/signal_ablation.py No search here, so it runs in ~1 minute.

data.text/html:
Data: 1591 training rows across 11 gameweeks; 12 test folds.

FULL has 28 features (26 numeric + 2 one-hot). NO_PTS3 drops 1, NO_FORM drops 3, FORM_ONLY keeps just ['points_last_3', 'xg_last_3', 'minutes_last_3'].

data.text/html: Per-gameweek: where does removing form actually hurt?

data.text/markdown:
Verdict

  • FULL: MAE 2.319, Spearman 0.321, Top-20 5.42/20
  • NO_PTS3: MAE 2.317 (-0.002), Spearman 0.316 (-0.004), Top-20 5.58 — FULL ranks better in 6/12 folds
  • NO_FORM: MAE 2.332 (+0.013), Spearman 0.311, Top-20 5.58
  • FORM_ONLY: MAE 2.508, Spearman 0.099, Top-20 3.92 — what three form columns alone can do
  • MEAN: Spearman 0.000 (chance level); SORT_BY_PTS3: Spearman 0.120, Top-20 4.33 (is the model smarter than just sorting by form?)
Even with all form removed the model ranks almost as well — the non-form features (xG rates, ICT, fixture/team strength, cost) carry real standalone signal. Read the critical question directly off NO_PTS3: that row is 'how would we predict without knowing points_last_3'. If its Spearman/Top-20 holds near FULL, the rest of the sheet compensates; if it falls to FORM_ONLY/SORT levels, recent points were load-bearing.
